# compute_aromatic_cycles { #mofography.analyze.compute_aromatic_cycles }

```python
analyze.compute_aromatic_cycles(
    ase_atoms,
    *,
    force_recompute=False,
    expand_isomorphisms=True,
    default_ring_sizes=None,
    merge_duplicate_sites=True,
    expand_to_unit_cell=True,
)
```

Detect aromatic cycles and cache the result in ``ase_atoms.info["aromatic_cycles"]``.

1. Ensures covalent bonds are present (calls
   :func:`update_with_covalent_bonds` if needed).
2. Returns the cached list when ``force_recompute=False`` and the cache exists.
3. Otherwise runs unit-cell chordless cycle search on the C/N subgraph
   (:func:`find_aromatic_cycles_in_unit_cell`) and stores the result.

Used by :func:`~mofography.visualize.plot_aromatic_rings` (Plotly) and
:func:`~mofography.movies.make_aromatic_rings_trace` (Three.js).

## Bond-length tolerances

Borderline pymatgen bond orders are corrected using MIC distance cutoffs for
aromatic C–C and C–N (fused benzene, imidazole–benzene links, etc.). See
[Aromatic ring detection](../aromatic_ring_detection.qmd) for literature values,
threshold table, and debugging tips.
